## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CLAUDE.md` and `DESIGN_PRINCIPLES.md`
- [ ] I looked at the result myself on mobile and desktop, I did not just accept the AI output
- [ ] It matches the existing pages (header, footer, buttons, spacing, tone)
- [ ] Only design tokens and existing components are used (no hard-coded colors, fonts, inline styles)
- [ ] One H1, one primary action, navigation labels are literal
- [ ] Linked from the navigation (no orphan page)
- [ ] No placeholder text, emoji decoration, or invented stats
- [ ] No new dependencies
- [ ] Keyboard usable, alt text set, contrast OK
